r: Hush! Don't make such noise with all these monsters around!

hettar_10.m: Please help to find Norry. He is my only friend, and he is helpless without me.
r: The wolfhound down there had brown fur with a white patch on the breast. He was enjoying himself gnawing some huge bones.

hettar_10_4.m: This must be him! Go and get him here - be quick!
r: That would be of no use. This brute had attacked me, so I had to kill it.
This brute growled at me, but I got away unharmed.

hettar_10_6.m:
[Hettar fell on the floor]
Nooo! What did you do?!

hettar_1_2.m: Norry is my little doggie. He fell down the steep slope and has not found his way back yet.
r: A dog! He will be back soon... I better go now.
I have seen a great wolfhound down there a short while ago. But you say you are missing a little doggie.

hettar_1_4.m:
I can see these Gornauds myself. That's why I must find Norry urgently.
Nooorryyyy!

hettar_20.m: Please go down there and look for my doggie. Maybe he is injured? Bring him back! You must!
r: This brute attacked me, so I had to kill it.

hettar_20_10.m: Great! Go immediately, as long as he might be alive still.
r: I hope he will follow me.
I hope he will follow me.
I have no time just now. I'll be back soon.

hettar_20_20.m: I gave you my last piece of Wyrm meat for Norry. Did you lose it?

hettar_20_30.m: Good that you have mentioned it. I'll give you a nice raw piece of Wyrm meat that I have as food for Norry. He loves them.

hettar_30.m: I can read it in your face - there is no hope for Norry.
r: This brute attacked me, so I had to kill it.
This brute growled at me, but I got away and let it live.

hettar_50.m: Haha! You know what? Norry has come back all alone! You have made all the way down unnecessarily.
r: Now guess who had persuaded him to do so? He was absorbed by a pile of monster bones.

hettar_80.m: Thank you again a thousand times for rescuing my little Norry!

hettar_90.m:
My poor Norry! Why did you have to die so young?
* Sob *

hettar_dog.10: I found Hettar, a tough boy about my age, on top of Blackwater mountain. He kept calling for a certain Norry.
hettar_dog.20: Hettar's little dog Norry has run away. He was very anxious to find him. I promised to get Norry back.
hettar_dog.30: Hettar has given me a piece of Norry's favorite food.
hettar_dog.40: I have offered Hettar's piece of Wyrm meat to Norry, who took it eagerly.
hettar_dog.50: Norry ran off to reunite with Hettar.
hettar_dog.80: Hettar thanked me a thousand times for my help in finding Norry.
hettar_dog.90: I explained to Hettar that I killed Norry. Hettar broke down on the floor in agony.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
